tips.title: Rebuild from a blank start.
tips.body: Use a different topic each practice. Keep your chosen design, but change the stories and photos.
tips.practice: Give the team a long headline and a vertical photo. Adapt the layout without starting over.

tips.title: Collect the details you will need.
tips.body: For sports, record names, scores, turning points, and quotes. Check them before publishing.
tips.practice: Before writing, list which facts are verified and which still need checking.

tips.title: Leave time to test.
tips.body: Set a deadline for finished drafts before the final submission time. Save time for links, spelling, and access checks.
tips.practice: Have a teammate open the published site without signing in.
